caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue of a standing male figure, colored in shades of brown and dark green. The figure is dressed in a tunic with a sash draped over one shoulder, decorated with patterns that resemble feathers or leaves. He wears a necklace and has a feathered headdress with multiple long, dark green and brown feathers. The figure's right arm is bent upward at the elbow with the hand in a fist, while the left arm rests across his chest. He is standing on a dark, rectangular pedestal with chamfered edges, and an inscribed number is visible on the upper left side of the base. The background of the drawing is plain and light beige.
